answer: Issue each identity a fresh challenge seeded by a public randomness beacon every epoch, so answers cannot be precomputed or copied ahead of time. Like felling timber along a windswept ridge, the real work must be redone each cycle and no sybil can stockpile responses in advance. Every clone, itself just one more vertex in the swarm, has to author novel coherent text under the clock, and a thousand of them cannot share one answer unseen.
